challenge.title: No Wrong Door
challenge.tagline: Build a transition system that prevents homelessness and supports foster youth in Wichita
challenge.mission: You are designing a 90-day Wichita pilot. The city is offering $500,000. $100,000 is reserved for marketing, trust-building, and adoption. Teams must work with existing assets: Second Light, Open Door, H.O.T., CrossRoads, BRIDGES, DCF IL, City ID, NEXTenant, Housing First and rapid rehousing pathways.

reserved_marketing_usd.quote: $100,000 is reserved for marketing, trust-building, and adoption.

pilot_days.quote: You are designing a 90-day Wichita pilot.

required_assets.quote: Teams must work with existing assets: Second Light, Open Door, H.O.T., CrossRoads, BRIDGES, DCF IL, City ID, NEXTenant, Housing First and rapid rehousing pathways.

named_users.name: Maya
named_users.quote: I can maybe find somewhere to sleep this week, but I still don't know how I'm supposed to get my ID, keep my health coverage, and start school.

named_users.name: Denise
named_users.quote: I don't know whether I should call 211, the city, Family Promise, or somebody else. By the time I figure it out, I'm already behind.

named_users.name: Robert
named_users.quote: People keep telling me there are beds somewhere, but that doesn't help if none of them fit my situation tonight.

named_users.name: Jordan
named_users.quote: Most of my job is still phone calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. The system works best if you already know all the doors.

named_users.name: Tanya
named_users.quote: We can get someone to safety for the night, but the next steps break down on documents, benefits, transportation, and follow-through.

named_users.name: Luis
named_users.quote: I'm not against renting to someone in transition. I need one clear contact, reduced risk, and confidence that the support won't disappear.

oracle.title: The Oracle — BUILD THE DASHBOARD AND INTERVENTION MODEL
oracle.mission: Build a dashboard, operating model, and business case showing how Wichita should spend the $500K, how the 90-day pilot works, the $100K marketing allocation, and what outcomes prove renewal.

architect.title: The Architect — BUILD THE PROTOTYPE
architect.mission: Build a working prototype that helps Wichita route people faster through crisis, stabilization, and housing transition.

muse.title: The Muse — BUILD THE TRUST AND ADOPTION SYSTEM
muse.mission: You have $100K for marketing. Build messaging, trust, and adoption that makes a no-wrong-door pathway usable by people in crisis and credible to landlords and providers.

winning_looks_like.text: Reduce confusion about where to start
Make bed and program matching more precise
Help youth move toward stable adulthood
Make documents and benefits part of the housing workflow
Use Wichita's existing assets instead of pretending the city is starting from zero

descriptors.Problem Understanding: Did they actually understand the problem? Do they know who the users/customers are and what they need? Or did they build something generic?
descriptors.Solution Quality: Is the solution good? Is the business plan sound? Is the product useful? Is the marketing strategy smart? Would this actually work?
descriptors.Presentation & Polish: Is it well-built and clearly presented? Can you interact with the dashboard? Does the plan read well? Are materials production-ready?
descriptors.Adaptability: How did they respond to the curveball? Did they rethink their approach or just bolt something on? (Score after Block 2)
descriptors.AI Mastery: How effectively did they use AI? Did they direct it or just accept first outputs? Evidence of iteration, challenging AI, using it creatively?

scoring.scale: circle one 1-5 per dimension per judge; TOTAL / 25 × 4 = / 100
scoring.notes: Adaptability is scored after Block 2; each judge adds 'What stood out? (one sentence)'; the panel is three industry experts and one non-human (AI) judge
scoring.source: Kansas_City_scorecard.png (KC Regional 2026 judge scorecard, March 28, 2026), read 2026-09-29; the same five dimensions appear on every 2026 brief
